title: onboard-polaris-13b-v1.0-perf-profiles-changelog-automation
author: Maya Chen
description: Onboard Polaris-13B v1.0 into the model registry with complete metadata, performance profiles, and an automated changelog/release-notes step. Motivation: Polaris-13B is an open checkpoint we've validated for production inference; this PR adds the canonical registry entries (metadata + manifests), quantization/performance profiles for 8-bit and 4-bit variants, and a small automation script that appends release notes to the model changelog and kicks off the model-perf nightly job. Changes include: 1) models/polaris-13b/v1.0/metadata.json (schema-compliant metadata + provenance + example prompts), 2) perf/profiles/polaris-13b-v1.0.yaml (throughput/latency profiles for common hardware shapes and token lengths), 3) perf/benchmarks/polaris-13b-nightly.yml (nightly perf job entry), 4) scripts/changelog-automation.py (utility to generate changelog bullet and create Linear/Slack notification), 5) tests/regression/test_polaris_perf.py (basic perf regression checks used by CI), and 6) docs/models/polaris-13b.md (user-facing onboarding notes and guidance for picking quantization/shape). The description field below includes test plan and rollout: Test plan: CI runs unit checks and perf smoke (mocked) on PR; we ran internal perf harness on p4d and A10G shapes and attached sample results. Rollout: add model in registry; make hosted variant available behind feature flag; monitor perf/regression alerts for 72 hours; revert via quick rollback tag if regressions detected. Linear tickets: ENG-2345 (onboard Polaris), ENG-2401 (perf profile validation). No breaking changes to registry schema.

review_thread: Arjun Patel: Please include the quantization config used to produce the 4-bit numbers and note whether they're GPTQ/LLMQ style. Also add which seed and batch sizes were used for the baseline runs.

Maya Chen: Added a 'quantization_notes' section in perf profile and included batch/seed details. We used LLMQ-style per-channel quantization with seed 42 and batch sizes 1/8 for latency/throughput baselines respectively.
Lucia Martinez: CI perf smoke failed on first run (timeout on perf harness). Could you reduce wallclock for smoke runs or mock external telemetry?
Maya Chen: Adjusted CI workflow to use mocked perf harness for PR smoke tests and added a separate nightly job for real measurements. Re-ran CI and checks passed.
Ben Thompson: Docs look good. One nit: caller-facing examples should call out expected cost/latency tradeoffs for 8-bit vs 4-bit — added suggestion inline.
Maya Chen: Addressed nit, expanded docs with a small table summarizing tradeoffs and recommended targets. Ready to merge when CI is green.
release_notes:
- Onboard Polaris-13B v1.0: metadata, perf profiles (8-bit/4-bit), and examples.
- Added automation to generate model changelog entries and notify Linear/Slack when a model version is released.
- Nightly perf job configured for Polaris; baseline numbers included in perf profile file.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag gating in runtime required to expose hosted variant; follow rollout doc in docs/models/polaris-13b.md. Monitor perf/regression alerts and nightly job outputs for first 72 hours.
test_results_summary: Initial PR: CI unit + schema validation passed; perf-smoke mocked for PR. Nightly job: baseline runs completed on p4d and A10G shapes; 4-bit reduced memory by ~2.5x and improved throughput on longer sequences. No regressions observed.
